NC House, veto override, 2018-12-19: yea (tally 72–40); census gate: none.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (Roll Call 758)
findings.note: Voted aye (66 to 47) on second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill includes a process to remove voters flagged by a federal database as possibly not citizens, and a citizenship question and sworn statement on voter registration forms. The bill text has no photo ID section.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Motion 11 Concur (Roll Call 801)
findings.note: Voted aye (62 to 47) to concur with the Senate changes to HB 958. The bill was ratified 2026-08-06 and vetoed by the governor 2026-08-17. No override vote was shown on the bill page when fetched.

findings.motion: HB 958 ratified text, Section 2.3(b) and G.S. 163-83 citizenship on registration forms (context for the votes above, not a separate act by Potts)
findings.note: Ratified text says: "If the State Board of Elections received information regarding potential non-eligible citizens appearing on the State's voter registration records from a federal database on or after January 1, 2026, and a challenge has not been entered against a voter appearing on the information from the federal database and the voter has not otherwise been removed from the list of eligible voters in the State, then the State Board of Elections shall create a process for removing such voters from the State's voter registration records." This describes the bill he voted on, not his own words.
